impl LaneDrainForTheStrip {
    fn drain_controls_for_lane(&mut self, control: &mut Consumer<Record>) {
        while let Some(limit) = self.limit_for_the_current_block_of_the_lane
            && let Ok(record) = control.try_pop()
        {
            self.apply(record);
            let _ = limit;
        }
    }
}
